mainnetPolicy is the owner's launch decision of 2026-11-02: 5 of 7 signers, 6 of 7 for the unpause, the verifier switch and the locked remint, 3 guardians (cancel quorum 2), T = 0. The mainnet gate refuses any other token shape.
